name: clo-system
description: Course Monitoring and Assessment System for Course Learning Outcomes (CLO System)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n CLIENT,SERVER -c blue,green "npm run dev -w app/client" "npm run dev -w app/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w app/client && npm run build -w app/server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w app/client && npm run lint -w app/server
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint -w app/client -- --fix && npm run lint -w app/server -- --fix
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w app/client && npm run typecheck -w app/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w app/client && npm run test -w app/server
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w app/client && npm run test:coverage -w app/server
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
